summary: Practise text preparation, model evaluation and NLP workflows with Python, scikit-learn and Transformers. Explore the course and its practical outline.
lede: Natural language processing for text analytics helps practitioners turn text into evaluated models and usable inference workflows. It is for NLP engineers, text analytics specialists and data scientists who need to build reliable text-analysis workflows, with practice preparing labelled data, creating TF-IDF baselines and evaluating model errors across classes and text types.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate practitioners who already work with Python or text data and need to make NLP model outputs more reliable, interpretable and usable in applications.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of Python and basic machine-learning concepts is expected. Python programming is required for the practical exercises; prior experience preparing or analysing text data is useful.
